candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail with 502 and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment logs show 503 on /readyz too, suggesting payment is unhealthy; exact internal fault (config vs dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout->order->payment chain failing: payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations, order returns 502, gateway checkout returns 502. Payment logs confirm repeated 503s on /v1/authorizations and /readyz. Inventory/redis path succeeds (200).
